title: 加法重复多少次归零？
How many additions return to zero?
text: 特征是同时使所有元素满足 na=0 的最小正整数；若不存在这样的正整数，就定义特征为 0。这个定义适用于没有单位元的环。
The characteristic is the least positive integer n annihilating every element additively; it is defined as zero if no such n exists. This definition also applies to rings without identity.
example: char ℤ=0，char ℤ₆=6，char 𝔽₅[x]=5。无限环也可以有正特征；特征不是元素个数。
The characteristics of ℤ, ℤ₆ and 𝔽₅[x] are 0, 6 and 5. An infinite ring can have positive characteristic; characteristic is not cardinality.

title: 有单位元时，只需追踪 1
With an identity, track only 1
text: 有单位元时，特征等于 1 在加法群中的有限阶；若该阶无限，特征为 0。不要把这里的加法阶误作乘法阶。
For a unital ring, finite characteristic equals the additive order of 1. If that order is infinite, the characteristic is zero. This is an additive order, not a multiplicative order.
proof: 若 n1=0，则对任意 a∈R，na=(n1)a=0；所以能消去 1 的整数也能消去整个环。
If n1=0, then na=(n1)a=0 for every a.
若 na=0 对所有 a 成立，当然 n1=0。因此两类正整数完全相同，最小值也相同；都不存在时特征为 0。
Conversely, an integer annihilating every element annihilates 1. The two sets of positive integers coincide, giving the same minimum or characteristic zero.

title: 整环的特征只能是 0 或素数
A domain has characteristic zero or prime
text: 整环和域的特征若为正数，必为素数。一般环却可以有合数特征，例如 ℤ₆。
A domain, and hence a field, has either characteristic zero or prime characteristic. General rings may have composite characteristic, as ℤ₆ does.
proof: 若特征 n>0，由 1≠0 得 n>1。假设 n=uv，1<u,v<n。
If n>0 is the characteristic, then n>1 since 1≠0. Suppose n=uv with 1<u,v<n.
由最小性，u1 与 v1 均非零；但 (u1)(v1)=n1=0，产生零因子矛盾。
Minimality makes u1 and v1 nonzero, while their product is n1=0, contradicting the domain property.
warning: 反向不成立：𝔽₂[x]/(x²) 的特征是素数 2，却有非零零因子 [x]。
The converse fails: 𝔽₂[x]/(x²) has prime characteristic 2 but the nonzero zero-divisor [x].

title: 每个有单位元的环都接收整数
The canonical map from the integers
text: 该映射是环同态；其像是由 1 生成的子环。特征为 n>0 时，像同构于 ℤₙ；特征为 0 时，像同构于 ℤ。
The map n↦n1 is a ring homomorphism whose image is the subring generated by 1. Its image is ℤₙ in characteristic n>0, and ℤ in characteristic zero.
proof: (m+n)1=m1+n1，(m1)(n1)=(mn)1，所以同时保加法与乘法。
The identities (m+n)1=m1+n1 and (m1)(n1)=(mn)1 prove the homomorphism property.
正特征 n 时，nℤ 包含于核；对任意核中整数用带余除法与 n 的最小性，得核恰为 nℤ。
In characteristic n>0, division with remainder and minimality of n show that the kernel is exactly nℤ.
特征 0 时核为零。分别应用同态基本定理得到结论。
In characteristic zero the kernel is zero. Apply the first isomorphism theorem.

title: 每个域最小的算术核心
The smallest field inside a field
text: 没有真子域的域称素域。任何域都包含唯一的最小子域：特征 0 时是 ℚ 的一个副本，特征 p 时是 𝔽ₚ 的一个副本。这里只讨论基本性质，不引入扩张次数。
A prime field has no proper subfield. Every field contains a unique smallest subfield: a copy of ℚ in characteristic zero or of 𝔽ₚ in characteristic p. No extension degree is needed here.
proof: 任意子域的单位元 e 满足 e²=e 且 e≠0，在域中消去得 e=1。因此每个子域都含所有整数倍 n1。
A subfield identity e satisfies e²=e and e≠0, so cancellation gives e=1. Every subfield therefore contains all n1.
特征 p 时，这些元素已经构成 𝔽ₚ。特征 0 时，每个子域还必须包含 (a1)(b1)⁻¹，b≠0。
In characteristic p these elements form 𝔽ₚ. In characteristic zero any subfield must also contain (a1)(b1)⁻¹ for b≠0.
交叉相乘说明 a/b↦(a1)(b1)⁻¹ 良定义且单射，并保持两种运算，其像为子域。
Cross multiplication proves that a/b↦(a1)(b1)⁻¹ is well-defined, injective and operation-preserving; its image is a subfield.
所得子域被所有子域包含，因此最小且唯一，自身也不可能有真子域。
This subfield is contained in every subfield, so it is uniquely minimal and itself prime.

title: 正特征中的二项式捷径
The binomial shortcut in prime characteristic
text: 特征 p 为素数的交换环中，p 次幂保持加法和乘法，称 Frobenius 同态。交换性是二项式展开的必要条件。
In a commutative ring of prime characteristic p, the p-th power map preserves addition and multiplication: the Frobenius homomorphism. Commutativity is needed for the binomial argument.
proof: 对 1≤k≤p−1，整数二项式系数 C(p,k) 被 p 整除，因为分子含一个 p，分母 k!(p−k)! 不含 p 因子。
For 1≤k≤p−1, p divides C(p,k): the numerator contains p while k!(p−k)! does not.
二项式展开的中间项在特征 p 中全为零，故 (a+b)ᵖ=aᵖ+bᵖ。交换性还给出 (ab)ᵖ=aᵖbᵖ。
The middle binomial terms vanish in characteristic p. Commutativity also gives (ab)ᵖ=aᵖbᵖ.
warning: 在 𝔽ₚ[x] 中 xᵖ≠x；Frobenius 是同态不代表它总是恒等映射。
In 𝔽ₚ[x], xᵖ≠x. Being a homomorphism does not make Frobenius the identity.

question: 𝔽₅[x] 的特征是？
What is the characteristic of 𝔽₅[x]?
reason: 每个系数加 5 次为 0，而常数 1 的加法阶为 5；环虽无限，特征仍为 5。
Adding any coefficient five times gives zero, and the constant 1 has additive order 5.

question: 下面哪一个数不可能是域的特征？
Which cannot be the characteristic of a field?
reason: 域是整环，正特征必须为素数。
A field is a domain, whose positive characteristic must be prime.

question: 特征 0 的域的最小子域同构于什么？
What is the smallest subfield of a characteristic-zero field isomorphic to?
reason: 子域包含所有整数倍 1，并必须包含它们的非零分母分式。
A subfield contains all integer multiples of 1 and all their fractions with nonzero denominators.

question: 在 𝔽₃[x] 中，(x+1)³ 等于？
In 𝔽₃[x], what is (x+1)³?
reason: 中间二项式系数都为 3，在特征 3 中消失。
The middle coefficients vanish in characteristic 3.

question: 证明整环不可能有合数特征 n=uv（1<u,v<n）。
Prove a domain cannot have composite characteristic n=uv with 1<u,v<n.
reason: 特征的最小性使 u1、v1 都非零，但它们的乘积是 uv1=n1=0，违背无零因子。
Minimality of n makes u1 and v1 nonzero, yet their product is n1=0, contradicting the domain property.
